zh.name: 机构登录与模型接入
zh.summary: 通过浏览器登录兼容的机构网关，发现模型并自动续期。支持 LiteLLM OAuth 与实验性 oidc-llm 接入。

en.name: Identity & model access
en.summary: Sign in to a compatible gateway through your browser, discover models and renew tokens. Supports LiteLLM OAuth and experimental oidc-llm integration.

zh.name: Knowledge Studio
zh.summary: 把资料变成报告、演示、思维导图、测验与闪卡；配套成果服务提供 Office 预览和媒体制作，与对话共用。

en.name: Knowledge Studio
en.summary: Turn materials into reports, presentations, mind maps, quizzes and flashcards, with companion artifact services for Office previews and media creation shared with conversations.

zh.name: 选段批注
zh.summary: 选中回复片段添加批注，保留来源编号，多条一起发送；复用 DSH 的输入框与草稿。

en.name: Response annotations
en.summary: Comment on selected passages, keep numbered references and send multiple annotations together using DSH’s composer and drafts.

zh.name: 侧边聊天
zh.summary: 从消息或选区开启侧聊，带着历史快照继续提问；与主会话分别进行，关闭后归档。可与批注插件联动。

en.name: Side chat
en.summary: Ask follow-up questions from a message or selection with a snapshot of the source history. Side chats run separately, archive on close and optionally integrate with annotations.

zh.name: 决策工具
zh.summary: 通过 SystemOne 服务按标签分类、判断条件概率或按量表评分，配套决策技能；配置服务地址、模型和认证后启用。

en.name: Decision tools
en.summary: Classify, estimate condition probabilities and score against rubrics through a SystemOne service, with a companion skill. Configure the endpoint, model and authentication before enabling it.

zh.name: 文献检索
zh.summary: 检索 DBLP、arXiv 文献，获取 BibTeX 与可用全文，把研究资料接入后续任务。

en.name: Literature search
en.summary: Search DBLP and arXiv, retrieve BibTeX and available full text, and bring research sources into your next task.

zh.name: 本地记忆
zh.summary: 管理本地记忆、检索历史对话，让后续任务接得上已有背景。记忆在本机管理。

en.name: Local memory
en.summary: Manage local memory and search past conversations so new tasks can pick up existing context. Memories are managed on your machine.

zh.name: 邮件助手
zh.summary: 通过 IMAP 查信、经授权用 SMTP 发信。可在设置中开启新邮件提醒，查看发件人、主题和正文片段，不改变邮件已读状态。

en.name: Mail assistant
en.summary: Search mail over IMAP and send via SMTP with authorization. Turn on new-mail reminders to see the sender, subject and a short excerpt without marking messages as read.

zh.name: 日历与日程
zh.summary: 在月历或周历安排日程、设置重复与提醒，也可在对话中添加日程。支持 ICS 导入、导出和订阅；接入机构校历后可查看教学周和学年总览。

en.name: Calendar & schedule
en.summary: Plan events, recurrences and reminders in month or week view, or add an event in chat. Import, export or subscribe to ICS calendars. Connecting an institutional calendar adds teaching weeks and an academic-year overview.

zh.name: 桌面宠物
zh.summary: 让桌宠提示任务状态和插件通知，例如新邮件。在设置中开启桌宠、选择形象；邮件提醒在邮件助手中单独开启。

en.name: Desktop pet
en.summary: Choose a companion in Settings to see task updates and plugin notifications on your desktop. To show new mail, also enable reminders in the mail assistant.

zh.name: 外部智能体
zh.summary: 连接本机 Codex、Cursor 或其他 ACP 智能体，在对话中委派任务。默认关闭，可在插件页启用并配置连接。

en.name: External agents
en.summary: Connect local Codex, Cursor or other ACP agents and delegate tasks from a conversation. Disabled by default; enable it and configure connections from the Plugins page.

zh.name: 远程访问
zh.summary: 通过中继配对手机或另一台电脑，在浏览器里继续本机会话、处理审批。公版需先配置并测试中继；机构发行版可预设中继和账号登录。

en.name: Remote access
en.summary: Pair a phone or another computer to continue a desktop conversation and handle approvals in its browser. Configure and test a relay first; institutional editions can provide a relay and account sign-in.
